posts.description: NIST Limits CVE Enrichment After 263% Surge in Vulnerability Submissions A couple of critical changes from NIST on how we challenge CVE’s in our infrastructure. Any CVE submission that doesn't meet these thresholds will be marked as "Not Scheduled." The idea, NIST said, is to focus on CVEs that have the maximum potential for widespread impact.
